notes: HOST GAME: life, SINGLE or TEAM, who's playing, deck(s), then the table lobby -- a join code and five seats that fill as devices join
JOIN GAME: the code, then the same questions; the host seats you (no more two devices in seat 1)
Only the host has START GAME; everyone has LEAVE (the host's closes the table for all). Joiners get a GAME ON prompt
The table face: tap an opponent's LIFE to attack, their NAME to open them; drag from your own total too. OUT seats say so
One turn lens at the foot: END TURN (yours, gold), START TURN, or whose turn it is; the turn number has its own chip
Battle screen: LIFELINK -- what you deal, you gain when it resolves
START GAME on one device: SINGLE or TEAMS, the knob sets the player count, life has an OTHER; hold a name to clear it
Deck picker: KEY CARD (Scryfall) names the deck after the card and puts its art on the face; NO DECK skips
